rules.title: Recovery of real property
rules.notes: Applies to actions for recovery of possession of real property; adverse possession threshold

rules.title: Contract or liability, express or implied
rules.notes: Covers most general contract claims; does not apply to UCC Article 2 sales

rules.title: Personal injury / Tort

deadline.trigger_event: date of injury; fraud/deceit: from discovery

rules.notes: Assault, battery, false imprisonment, personal injury not arising on contract

rules.title: Medical malpractice

deadline.trigger_event: discovery of injury or reason to discover

rules.notes: Fraud exception: if provider committed fraud, 2 years from discovery of fraud (no 5-year cap)

deadline.trigger_event: date claim arises under agreement or Chapter 90
Claimant under 18 or disabling mental condition at accrual
deadline.absolute_cap: 5 years beyond SOL or 1 year after disability removal

rules.title: Summons / Response Time
rules.notes: Defendant has 30 days to appear and defend after service

rules.title: Mandatory Conferral
rules.notes: Good-faith conferral required before filing most motions (ORCP 21, 23, 36-46, 55)

rules.title: Addresses and Telephone Numbers
rules.notes: All pleadings must include current address and telephone number of filing party/attorney

rules.title: Court Website
rules.notes: Court website is the primary source for current SLR text, local forms, and scheduling information.

rules.title: Remote Appearances and Exhibits
rules.notes: Remote appearances require advance permission. All exhibits must be pre-submitted before the hearing date.

rules.title: Public Access Coverage
rules.notes: Media coverage and recording are subject to court approval. Requests must be submitted in advance.

rules.title: Settlement Conference
rules.notes: Mandatory settlement conferences may be required. Persons with full settlement authority must attend in person or by phone.

rules.title: Court Scheduling
rules.notes: All matters must be set through the court administrator

rules.title: Stipulate to Exhibits
rules.notes: Parties are encouraged to stipulate to exhibit authenticity and admissibility before trial to streamline proceedings.

rules.title: AV Equipment Approval
rules.notes: Advance court approval is required for any audio-visual equipment used in court. Submit requests before the hearing or trial date.

rules.title: Parent Education Class
rules.notes: Required in all cases involving custody or parenting time. Must be completed within the time specified by the court.

rules.title: Parenting Plan Specificity
rules.notes: Parenting plans must address residential schedule, holidays, decision-making, transportation, and communication. Vague or incomplete plans may be rejected.

rules.title: Guardianship Requirements
rules.notes: Specific requirements for visitor reports, background checks, bonding, annual reporting, and guardianship plan review.

rules.title: Juvenile Exhibits
rules.notes: Specific procedures for exhibit submission in juvenile court proceedings.

rules.title: Mandatory Mediation — Custody/Parenting
rules.notes: Mediation is required before trial in all custody and parenting time disputes.

rules.title: Mediation Accommodations
rules.notes: Power imbalance accommodations available for mediation.

rules.title: Mediation Confidentiality
rules.notes: Confidentiality protected in mediation proceedings.

rules.title: Mediation Exemptions
rules.notes: Exemptions available for DV or inability to mediate.

rules.title: Mediator Appointment
rules.notes: If parties cannot agree on a mediator, the court appoints one from the qualified mediator list.

rules.title: Durable Guardianship
rules.notes: Provides for juvenile guardianship when child cannot safely return home within reasonable time.

rules.title: Permanent Guardianship
rules.notes: Grounds same as termination of parental rights. Parent may not petition to vacate.

rules.title: Community Guardianship
rules.notes: Durable guardianship to a licensed child-care agency for children 16 or older.

rules.title: Establishing Durable Guardianship
rules.notes: Requires findings that child cannot safely return to parent, adoption not appropriate, and guardian suitable.

rules.title: Guardianship Order and Reports
rules.notes: Requires annual guardian's report due within 30 days of anniversary of appointment.

rules.title: Review, Modification, and Vacation
rules.notes: Court may modify or vacate order based on child's best interests and amelioration of conditions.

rules.title: Duration of Wardship
rules.notes: Jurisdiction continues until dismissal, transfer, termination, adoption, or ward becomes 21.
